name: currency_rates
sql: CREATE TABLE currency_rates (code TEXT PRIMARY KEY, symbol TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NOT NULL, fiat_per_btc TEXT, fetched_at REAL, source TEXT)

name: ecash_inboxes
sql: CREATE TABLE ecash_inboxes (owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY, next_poll REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: incoming_payments
sql:
CREATE TABLE incoming_payments (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, zap_id TEXT UNIQUE,
                created REAL NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, encrypted BLOB NOT NULL,
                next_check REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, lease TEXT, lease_until REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, history_written INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: lightning_handles
sql: CREATE TABLE lightning_handles (normalized_handle TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL)

name: nfc_card_pins
sql:
CREATE TABLE nfc_card_pins (
              pairing TEXT PRIMARY KEY, card_id TEXT UNIQUE,
              verifier BLOB NOT NULL, disclosure BLOB, acknowledged INTEGER)

name: nfc_cards
sql:
CREATE TABLE nfc_cards (
              id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, wallet_id TEXT NOT NULL,
              terminal TEXT NOT NULL, verifier TEXT NOT NULL, payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
              payload BLOB, created INTEGER NOT NULL, expires INTEGER NOT NULL,
              activated INTEGER, revoked INTEGER)

name: nfc_issuer
sql: CREATE TABLE nfc_issuer (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, encrypted BLOB NOT NULL)

name: nfc_login_attempts
sql:
CREATE TABLE nfc_login_attempts (
          card_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: nfc_login_nonces
sql:
CREATE TABLE nfc_login_nonces (
          nonce TEXT PRIMARY KEY, expires REAL NOT NULL)

name: nfc_login_policy
sql:
CREATE TABLE nfc_login_policy (
              card_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, require_pin INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(require_pin IN (0,1)))

name: nfc_login_requests
sql:
CREATE TABLE nfc_login_requests (
              pairing TEXT PRIMARY KEY, card_id TEXT UNIQUE, identity BLOB NOT NULL,
              requested INTEGER NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'requested')

name: nfc_pairings
sql:
CREATE TABLE nfc_pairings (
              id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, terminal TEXT NOT NULL, request_key TEXT NOT NULL,
              verifier TEXT NOT NULL, invitation BLOB, created REAL NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL,
              state TEXT NOT NULL, owner TEXT, wallet_id TEXT, card_id TEXT,
              UNIQUE(terminal,request_key))

name: outgoing_payments
sql: CREATE TABLE outgoing_payments (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, encrypted BLOB NOT NULL, created REAL NOT NULL, request_key TEXT, started_at REAL)

name: pos_audit
sql:
CREATE TABLE pos_audit (
                id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, terminal TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, at REAL NOT NULL)

name: pos_challenges
sql:
CREATE TABLE pos_challenges (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, terminal TEXT NOT NULL, session TEXT NOT NULL,
                operation TEXT NOT NULL, public_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                message TEXT NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL)

name: pos_limits
sql:
CREATE TABLE pos_limits (
                bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY, count INTEGER NOT NULL, expires REAL NOT NULL)

name: pos_receipts
sql:
CREATE TABLE pos_receipts (
                terminal TEXT NOT NULL, request_key TEXT NOT NULL, body_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
                id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, owner TEXT NOT NULL, created REAL NOT NULL,
                PRIMARY KEY(terminal, request_key))

name: pos_sessions
sql:
CREATE TABLE pos_sessions (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, terminal TEXT NOT NULL, verifier TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                expires REAL NOT NULL)

name: pos_terminals
sql:
CREATE TABLE pos_terminals (
                id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, wallet_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                name TEXT NOT NULL, verifier TEXT NOT NULL, created REAL NOT NULL,
                activation_until REAL NOT NULL, public_key TEXT, fingerprint TEXT,
                activated REAL, last_seen REAL, revoked REAL)

name: record_capabilities
sql: CREATE TABLE record_capabilities (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, encrypted BLOB NOT NULL)

name: service_identity
sql: CREATE TABLE service_identity (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), npub TEXT NOT NULL)

name: user_currency_preferences
sql: CREATE TABLE user_currency_preferences (owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY, currency TEXT NOT NULL)

name: user_display_preferences
sql: CREATE TABLE user_display_preferences (owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY, language TEXT NOT NULL)

name: user_preferences
sql: CREATE TABLE user_preferences (owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY, handle TEXT NOT NULL, normalized_handle TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)

name: user_social_preferences
sql: CREATE TABLE user_social_preferences (owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY, npub TEXT NOT NULL)

name: wallet_message_submissions
sql: CREATE TABLE wallet_message_submissions (token TEXT PRIMARY KEY, created REAL NOT NULL)

name: wallet_requests
sql: CREATE TABLE wallet_requests (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, owner TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, created REAL NOT NULL, encrypted BLOB NOT NULL)

name: wallets
sql:
CREATE TABLE wallets (
                owner TEXT PRIMARY KEY, wallet_id TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
                encrypted BLOB NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL,
                lease TEXT, lease_until REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

name: incoming_due
sql: CREATE INDEX incoming_due ON incoming_payments(state,next_check)

name: incoming_owner
sql: CREATE INDEX incoming_owner ON incoming_payments(owner,created)

name: nfc_card_owner
sql: CREATE INDEX nfc_card_owner ON nfc_cards(owner)

name: outgoing_request
sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX outgoing_request ON outgoing_payments(owner,request_key) WHERE request_key IS NOT NULL

name: pos_terminal_owner
sql: CREATE INDEX pos_terminal_owner ON pos_terminals(owner)
